name: Lamp Relay
tagline: Wi-Fi control for existing lamp circuits, wall pushbuttons keep working.
description: An ESP32-based relay module that switches household lamp circuits over Wi-Fi. Your existing wall pushbuttons stay in use: their inputs are optocoupler-isolated, so the board reads them safely. Control it from the app, via MQTT or plain HTTP. Installation in fixed wiring must be carried out by a licensed electrician.

name: Access Point
tagline: A compact Wi-Fi access point that plugs into any LAN socket.
description: Extends your home network with a dedicated 2.4 GHz access point. Connect it to a LAN socket, plug in the power adapter, and it broadcasts your network wherever coverage is weak. External antennas for better range.
